rule: Never assign DIRECT_NUMERIC from branch-topic adjacency alone; exact identity compatibility and measured quantity compatibility are required.
If release_identity differs and no frozen transport mapping exists, maximum class is PARTIAL_STRUCTURAL.
If event_set_identity differs and the tested dimension cannot be isolated, classify PARTIAL_STRUCTURAL or UNRESOLVED_ATTRIBUTION; never pure model dependence.
B03 numerical selection bridges inherit BLOCKED_PUBLIC_ASSET unless new public assets are introduced in a separately preregistered extension.
B04 primary remnant/ringdown numerical bridges inherit BLOCKED_SCHEMA unless the unresolved schema is independently resolved under a new freeze.
B07 cannot support a DIRECT_NUMERIC replication-result edge because no strict/adapted replication test was executed; identity/transport statements only.
B08 C11/C12 remain representation-limited primary comparisons; Phase5 post-hoc bright diagnostics cannot be promoted retroactively.
A branch closure label is immutable in XBICA. Integration may add relationship metadata but must not upgrade/downgrade the branch's scientific closure.
A BLOCKED node is evidence, not missing paperwork: it must remain visible in the final atlas.
No cross-branch causal attribution is licensed by correlation, ordering, or conceptual upstream/downstream position alone.
No hidden numerical propagation may be inferred across structural edges. Any future numerical propagation requires its own preregistered contract.
Identity joins must preserve provenance: every resolved anchor in Phase2+ must cite branch, Master SHA, source path and join-key value.
